summary: Iter 123aa · Tested Draft claim live-summary refresh (list + detail) and Attached-Invoices head column for Gwalior Madhavrao Scindia Trophy claim. Backend live-summary rollup works (summary dict populated with real numbers ₹5,23,044 invoiced / ₹4,46,481 eligible / ₹19,150 over-budget). Frontend list card and 4 detail tiles now render real numbers. HOWEVER the Attached Invoices section on the Draft claim detail still shows '(0) No invoices referenced.' because the Draft doc's `invoice_ids` array is empty in DB and the fix didn't also live-project the referenced invoice IDs. The head-column code change is inert since there are no invoice rows to display it against. Print PDF (Ctrl-P) inherits the same DOM, so the Head column will not appear in printed output either — regression from user's original report #3 ("print PDF didn't tag each invoice with its budget head") is only partially fixed.

minor.issue: Top-level fields the fix tried to set (claim_amount_inr, invoiced_total_inr, eligible_total_inr) come back as null because TournamentReimbursementClaim model has extra='ignore' and no such fields defined; response_model strips them. Frontend still works because it reads from summary.eligible_total_inr, but the review-request assertion of a non-zero top-level `claim_amount_inr` is not satisfied.

ui_bugs.issue: Draft Gwalior claim (id 546330a0-…) shows '(0) No invoices referenced.' even though summary reports invoice_count=9 and 9 approved invoices exist in DB for DIV-GWL on this tournament. The Head column code is present (line ~571-577) but no rows render.

integration_issues.issue: Component fetches attached invoices via claim.invoice_ids (line 385-388 of ReimbursementClaims.jsx). For a Draft claim the doc.invoice_ids is [] so the array is empty. Fix must either (a) also live-refresh invoice_ids/extra_expense_ids on the Draft doc when computing summary, or (b) have the detail component fall back to fetching invoices via /api/tournament-invoices?tournament_id&body_id when invoice_ids is empty and status==='Draft'.

action_items: In routes/reimbursement_claims.py list_claims + get_claim Draft-branch, additionally populate d['invoice_ids'] (and d['extra_expense_ids']) from the same live query used by _compute_summary so the Attached Invoices list is non-empty on Draft claims. This will also fix the print-PDF Head-column visibility.

Either add claim_amount_inr / invoiced_total_inr / eligible_total_inr as Optional[float] fields on TournamentReimbursementClaim OR drop the assignment in the route since summary already carries them (frontend uses summary.eligible_total_inr). Currently the fields silently disappear during response_model serialization — misleading.
Verify print-PDF export (Ctrl-P) after invoice_ids projection is added; screenshot Attached Invoices table with visible HEAD column.
Deferred (3rd iter): (4) per-invoice AI diff chip · (5) tournament AI digest — still not tested here per review request.

rca of the issue: Iter 123aa fix live-refreshed the `summary` dict on Draft claims but did not touch the referenced invoice_ids/extra_expense_ids array on the doc. The frontend Attached Invoices section (and by extension the print PDF export) reads exclusively from `claim.invoice_ids` to fetch and render rows. Because a Draft claim never runs the submit-time snapshotting that would freeze those IDs, the array stays [], so 0 invoices render — the Head column change (line 571-577 of ReimbursementClaims.jsx) never has a row to attach to. Additionally, the top-level scalar fields (claim_amount_inr, invoiced_total_inr, eligible_total_inr) set by the backend fix are dropped by TournamentReimbursementClaim's response_model (extra='ignore', fields not declared), so they arrive as null on the client — a red herring since the frontend was already reading from summary.eligible_total_inr.
